C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254-V2.Summary: Publish patch release 0.4.1 from the exact clean main after all selected feature changes completed their merge, post-merge and terminal archive lifecycle.
C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254-V2.Problem: The current main includes document-runtime reliability and the desktop plans lifecycle improvement, but the committed version metadata and public release artifacts still identify 0.4.0.

Goals.Goal: Set all authoritative committed version markers to 0.4.1 in one reproducible GitHub-side change.
Document only user-visible changes reachable from the exact release base.
Prove full regression, offline bundle, systemd installation, update/rollback and strict OCR gates before tagging.
Publish tag v0.4.1 and a non-draft, non-prerelease GitHub Release from the exact post-merge main commit.

Constraints.Constraint: No unmerged, historical, draft or experimental branch is included.
No mobile mode, mobile navigation, bottom sheet, gesture or mobile-only transition is included.
No SQLite migration, schema change, destructive reset, Docker, CDN, mandatory Internet, cloud or mandatory LLM dependency is introduced.
Applied SQL migrations and immutable document sources remain byte-identical.
A temporary branch-only GitHub workflow may update existing version files atomically after baseline; it must delete itself in the same commit and must not appear in the pull-request diff.
Tag and GitHub Release are created only after release PR squash merge and successful exact-main post-merge CI.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Implement remaining source-row or plan-detail work from issue 236.
Change package, installation, backup, migration or recovery architecture.
Replace or mutate the v0.4.0 tag or release assets.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: VERSION, package.json and package-lock.json agree on 0.4.1.
README and ROADMAP identify 0.4.1 as the current release without rewriting historical migration or release evidence.
Release notes describe strict document-runtime activation and repair, Unicode-safe uploads, classified Docomator diagnostics and the desktop `Текущие | Архив` control.
Release notes explicitly state that mobile-specific modes and unfinished branch work are not included.
The temporary updater workflow is absent from the final branch diff.
Version tests, complete project CI, release-gate, full offline Debian 12, systemd, backup/restore and GRACE final pass on one exact PR head.
After squash merge and exact-main post-merge CI, tag v0.4.1 points to that exact commit and the GitHub Release is published with verified assets and SHA-256.
A separate archive-only PR leaves C-RELEASE-0-4-1-254-V2 in terminal applied state.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact release commit, tag, release metadata, offline artifacts and checks all identify version 0.4.1 and preserve the supported 0.4.0 upgrade path.
